caption: Run-to-run stability of the stance classifier at the provider-default temperature.
rows: 14 of 300 (all adjacent; no shift across the critical-favourable boundary)
notes: The 300 stance-validation records were classified twice more with the production v1 configuration. Agreement is between the two re-inference runs, not against human coding; canonical labels and human codes were not altered. CIs: bootstrap over records (1000, seed 42) for κ; Clopper-Pearson for raw agreement.
